images.screen: A · 한여름 빙고 — 녹는 율과 오늘 온 손님
images.prompt: Actual in-game screenshot of a 2D hand-painted management sim set in late Joseon-dynasty Korea, 16:9 landscape, full-bleed, no device frame, no poster framing. Left two thirds: a large side cross-section of a traditional Korean stone ice storehouse (seokbinggo) buried under a grassy earth mound on the bank of the Han River in midsummer: granite arch ribs, a dark cool interior, layers of golden rice straw lining the vault walls, and a stepped pyramid of translucent pale-blue river ice blocks separated by thin layers of rice husk; several top blocks are visibly rounded and shrinking, water droplets fall and a shallow drainage channel along the floor holds melt water. Outside: hot orange-yellow summer sky, heat haze, a wooden door on the right side of the mound standing ajar with warm light spilling in. Painted with ink outlines and muted watercolor on hanji paper texture. Below it, a thin timeline chart on paper: 24 bars of ochre price columns labelled with seasonal terms "입하 소만 망종 하지 소서 대서 입추 처서" and a falling blue line for remaining ice, one small red seal-stamp square marking a contract due date. Right third: a clean UI panel on cream hanji paper with black ink typography: header reads "대서 2후  31℃  얼음 214덩이  돈 6,820푼"; a box titled "이번 후(닷새) 녹는 양" with a big blue number "22‰" and the line "기온 31℃ → 38 − 짚 4겹 20 + 문 1번 3"; a list titled "오늘 온 손님" with rows "어물전 34덩이 × 59푼", "약방 7덩이 × 96푼", "반가 잔치 21덩이 × 81푼", each with a black button "문 열고 판다"; a red-bordered row "궁 진상 · 계약" with a tilted red seal stamp; a wide black button at the bottom "문 닫고 닷새 보낸다". Elegant, calm, readable, Korean text crisp.

images.screen: B · 소한 채빙 — 강 얼음을 캐서 들인다
images.prompt: Actual in-game screenshot of a 2D hand-painted management sim set in late Joseon-dynasty Korea, 16:9 landscape, full-bleed, no device frame, no poster framing. Deep winter on the frozen Han River at dawn: pale grey-blue sky, falling snow, the river surface thick white ice with cut rectangular holes; small ink-drawn laborers in padded hanbok and straw hats saw ice with long saws and drag blocks on a wooden sledge toward a snow-covered earth mound; the mound is shown in side cross-section revealing a granite stone arch vault, half filled with neatly stacked pale-blue ice blocks and fresh golden straw along the walls. Ink outline and muted watercolor on hanji paper texture, cold palette with one warm red accent. Right third: cream hanji UI panel with black ink typography: header "소한 · 채빙 7/12일  −15℃  얼음 268덩이  돈 2,300푼"; a row of twelve small vertical gauges showing daily ice thickness, today's gauge outlined in red; text "오늘 얼음 두께 6치 → 캐면 48덩이 · 일꾼 삯 400푼" and a smaller grey note "내일 두께는 내일이 되어야 안다"; two buttons side by side "채빙한다 (−400푼)" in black and "쉰다" outlined; a box "단열  짚 3 / 6겹" with button "짚 한 겹 (−300푼)"; a wide black button "문을 봉하고 여름으로". Calm, austere, readable, Korean text crisp.
